equity.level_reason: No social-position dimension is analyzed; age is mentioned only as unavailable in a limitation, and MSM appears only in background on the national outbreak.

notes: Only descriptive statistics; no CIs or tests. Design inferred as outbreak investigation from the article's own word 'investigation'.
view_issues: Text says secondary cases experienced symptoms '21 days after exposure' in two places, apparently meaning 'within 21 days'. Total interviewed % (24.5) uses all 662 contacts though Tennessee interviewed none.
